name: MLVoca Free LLM API
description: A keyless Ollama-shaped endpoint for two small open models.
overview: MLVoca publishes a free, keyless POST /api/generate endpoint that follows Ollama's shape rather than OpenAI's: send a model and a prompt, get a completion back, streaming by default. Two small open models are served — TinyLlama 1.1B and DeepSeek R1 1.5B — with no published rate limit or token cap. It is a hobby-scale service for learning and experiments, so treat availability as best-effort.
free_access: No API key and no sign-up
No published rate or token limit
